summary: The GrpInstructorSummary module is part of a web application developed with ASP.NET. It is designed to present a summary view of group instructor schedules. The module includes functionality for selecting terms and sites, and it refreshes the displayed data based on user interaction.
purpose: To provide a summary view of group instructor schedules, allowing users to filter and view data by term and site.

workflows.name: Load Page
steps: Setup HSPnet page with master and footer label.
Check if the page is loaded for the first time (not postback).
Retrieve and display the agency name from user session.
Fill dropdown lists for term and site.

workflows.name: Refresh View
steps: Display the count of destinations in a label.

workflows.name: Select Term
steps: Fill the site dropdown based on selected term.

system_behavior: AutoPostBack on dropdown selection to update data.
Data source selection for grid view is based on session and term dates.
